label: Maximum health
explanation: Higher values give players more maximum health.

label: Maximum mana
explanation: Higher values give players more mana for spells.

label: Maximum stamina
explanation: Higher values give players more stamina.

label: Cold resistance
explanation: Higher values let players stay in cold areas longer before hypothermia.

label: Underwater breathing time
explanation: Higher values give players more oxygen for diving.

label: Weapon durability
explanation: When enabled, weapons wear out and need repairs. Disable to prevent weapons from breaking.

label: Hunger & starvation
explanation: When enabled, starving players lose health until they eat, drink, or die.

label: Food buff duration
explanation: Higher values make food bonuses last longer.

label: Time before starvation
explanation: Minutes spent hungry before starvation begins. Only applies when hunger and starvation are enabled.

label: Time allowed in the Shroud
explanation: Higher values let players remain in the Shroud longer.

label: Items dropped on death
explanation: Dropped backpack items are stored in a recoverable tombstone. Choose materials only, all backpack items, or keep everything.

label: Glider turbulence
explanation: When enabled, air turbulence affects gliding.

label: Weather frequency
explanation: Controls how often new weather events appear.

label: Fishing difficulty
explanation: Harder settings make fish stronger and the fishing minigame last longer.

label: Mining effectiveness
explanation: Higher values remove more terrain and yield more resources per hit.

label: Plant growth speed
explanation: Higher values increase plant growth speed.

label: Loot quantity
explanation: Higher values increase material quantities in loot from chests and defeated enemies.

label: Workstation production time
explanation: Scales production time at workstations. Lower values shorten production time.

label: Weapon salvage rune return
explanation: Controls the portion of upgrade runes returned when salvaging upgraded weapons. 0 returns none; 1 is the maximum return.

label: Weapon upgrade cost
explanation: Higher values require more runes to upgrade weapons.

label: Combat experience
explanation: Higher values award more experience from combat.

label: Mining experience
explanation: Higher values award more experience from mining. Set to 0 to disable mining experience.

label: Exploration & quest experience
explanation: Higher values award more experience from exploration and quests.

label: Enemy population
explanation: Controls how many enemies appear in the world.

label: Simultaneous attackers
explanation: Controls how many enemies can attack players at the same time.

label: Enemy damage
explanation: Higher values make ordinary enemies deal more damage. Does not affect bosses.

label: Enemy health
explanation: Higher values give ordinary enemies more health. Does not affect bosses.

label: Enemy stun resistance
explanation: Higher values make enemies take longer to stun. Does not affect bosses.

label: Enemy detection range
explanation: Higher values let enemies see and hear players from farther away. Does not affect bosses.

label: Boss damage
explanation: Higher values make boss attacks deal more damage.

label: Boss health
explanation: Higher values give bosses more health.

label: Enemy attack frequency
explanation: Higher values make enemies attack more frequently. Does not affect bosses.

label: Enemies attack only when provoked
explanation: When enabled, ordinary enemies do not attack until attacked first. Bosses remain hostile.

label: Progress lost when taming fails
explanation: Controls how much taming progress is lost when an animal is startled.

label: Day length
explanation: Duration of daylight in real-world minutes. Higher values make days longer.

label: Night length
explanation: Duration of nighttime in real-world minutes. Higher values make nights longer.

label: Shroud curse
explanation: Off prevents the curse. Increased doubles the normal chance of receiving it from relevant enemy attacks.
